segments.source: Request-level sparse neural routing and a controlled deployment protocol. Twenty-eight Node tests and fifty-two Python tests passed. A complete frozen training-to-deployment result was not produced in this audit. The repository explicitly distinguishes protocol readiness from superiority evidence.
Principal source paths: README.md; python/vsa_bench/router.py; python/vsa_bench/model.py; docs/​specs/​DS003-​experimental-​methodology.md; docs/​specs/​DS010-​dgx-​spark-​handoff.md.
Appendix B. Audit artifacts and reproduction boundaries
A01 · Input identity and selection

archive_manifest.json records the fifteen original archives with full SHA-256 hashes, member counts, and uncompressed sizes. The per-repository inventory files identify the relevant source and documentation paths available for inspection. Archive dates were not used to invent a development chronology. Untouched extracted snapshots were kept apart from execution copies.
A02 · Repository test executions

test_runs.json records the selected commands, exit codes, execution times, and log hashes for the main test pass. Additional VSAText and vsaLLM Python runs are recorded in the experiment metadata. Logs preserve all failures. Counts refer to each runner’s own test accounting; the book does not combine incompatible notions of tests, suites, fixtures, and assertions into a universal success statistic.
A03 · Original experiment reruns

experiment_runs.json, extra_runs.json, and extra2_runs.json record the selected experiment commands and their outcomes. The package retains regenerated Eos results, the three VSANash scenario files, autoResearchLib’s seven experiment result sets, the HoloProof error matrix, the SomaVM checkpoint report and configuration, and other selected outputs. The VSARepresentations matrix and incomplete BSP sweep remain available as console logs. Runtimes are not controlled hardware benchmarks.
A04 · Algebra and growth probes

new_probes/algebra_probe.mjs imports the supplied implementations and writes algebra_results.json. It tests positive confidence scaling, full sparse binding, metric isometry and distributivity, conditional similarity baselines, elastic payload growth, exact shared-factor semantics, exact term expansion, and atom-prefix stability. Counterexamples demonstrate failed contracts, not a universal impossibility result for the representation family.
A05 · Eos dual-readout experiment

new_probes/eos_dual_readout.cjs writes eos_dual_results.json. Data seed 424242 is fixed; dimensions are 16, 32, 128, 512, and 8192; each uses five codebook seeds. Both thresholds use training data only. The tested full-rank, unquantised linear encodings permit a dual readout, with floating-point coefficients. This is a causal diagnostic of the decoder, not a demonstration that HDC outperforms direct twelve-feature arithmetic.
A06 · Semantic and scope probes

new_probes/semantic_scope.mjs writes semantic_scope_results.json. It demonstrates the equal text encodings, trait-count metric behaviour, untrained-engine negation score, and four scope-sensitive HoloProof cases. The Boolean adapter enumerates four assignments and parses the actual emitted assertions. It is independent of the query executor but deliberately limited; no claim of full SMT coverage follows.
A07 · VSAVM repair and rerun

new_probes/vsavm_budget_order.patch moves the budgetMs declaration before its use. The original 305/307 result remains unchanged in the baseline log. logs/patched_full_VSAVM.log records the separate complete 307/307 test rerun. The patch changes declaration order, not the model’s learning semantics. It establishes removal of the observed runtime failure, not language generalisation.
A08 · Assertion and provenance register

claim_ledger.json, source_register.json, and AUTHORSHIP_AND_SCOPE.md connect the book’s main statements to source or execution records and mark proposals separately. The companion verification script checks selected stored result invariants. It is a consistency check over the evidence package, not a substitute for rerunning the repository experiments.

The package includes the original supplied ZIPs under source_archives/. A preparation script verifies their hashes and extracts them into a local snapshot directory. A separate probe runner creates fresh outputs without overwriting the archived audit results. Node.js is needed for the probes; the preparation and evidence checks use Python’s standard library. Large neural training, live model calls, and external solver installations remain outside this reproduction path. Dependencies for wider repository suites are not silently bundled or assumed.
References and novelty boundaries
These checked primary sources establish context, not an exhaustive novelty search. Failure to find an identical system would not establish priority.

L01. Kleyko, D., Rachkovskij, D. A., Osipov, E., and Rahimi, A. A Survey on Hyperdimensional Computing aka Vector Symbolic Architectures, Part I: Models and Data Transformations. ACM Computing Surveys, 55(6), 2022. DOI: 10.1145/3538531. Preprint: arXiv:2111.06077. Relevant to the diversity of VSA models and the need to specify the representation and its operations.
